subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and per-customer rate limits
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and per-customer rate limits

Hi Sophia ---

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side to make sure we're aligned and to capture next steps. Please reply with any corrections.

Key pain points you described:
- Billing spikes when multiple customers run large batch jobs; need per-customer quotas to prevent noisy neighbors.
- Lack of per-customer routing/policies today - want ability to route tiered customers to dedicated capacity vs shared.
- Need rate limits and burst controls at the customer level (RPS + token quotas).
- Observability gaps: need per-customer cost/latency breakdowns and audit logs for compliance.

Current stack:
- API gateway + homegrown request broker on AWS (ECS).
- Using embeddings service (managed) + Redis for caching; no unified inference platform today.

Success criteria for pilot / POC:
- Ability to enforce per-customer RPS and monthly token quotas.
- Route 2 customer tiers to a mix of shared & dedicated capacity with simple policy config.
- Per-customer telemetry (cost, 95p latency) surfaced in console.
- No regression in latency for priority customers (95p < 250ms target during POC).

Proposed next steps
1) I'll send a short MPA-style spreadsheet with proposed rate limits/quotas and an initial config example (attached).
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra and security teams (30-45m).
3) If that looks good we can scope a 4-week POC: onboarding, config, 2 pilot customers, measurement.

Attachments: redwood-multi-tenancy-controls-v1.pdf (controls overview) -- I'll follow up with the proposed MPA sheet.

If you're good with this, I'll book the technical deep-dive for the week of Nov 29.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@acmeai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and per-customer rate limits

Thanks Ben - this looks right. Couple clarifications from our side:

- Expected traffic per tier (estimates): Tier 1 ~500 RPS sustained with short bursts to 2k RPS, Tier 2 ~120 RPS, Tier 3 ~50 RPS.
- Monthly token quota per customer for Tier 1 is roughly 10M tokens; we want enforcement to prevent overages at the request routing layer.
- Important: we rely on prefix KV cache for embeddings in some flows. Will your platform support per-customer KV/prefix cache isolation or namespace-level caching?
- Security: we require SAML SSO and KMS integration for customer keys (bring-your-own-key). Also need audit logs retained for 1 year.
- Pricing: can you share a rough delta between shared vs dedicated capacity pricing and any minimum commitment?

I've attached a short PRD (acme-pr-requirements.docx) that lists flows we want covered in the POC.

Would prefer the deep-dive the week of Nov 29 as well. Please include your solutions engineer and someone from product on the invite.

--Sophia
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme AI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@acmeai.com>

Date: 2026-11-10T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Discovery recap: multi-tenancy controls and per-customer rate limits - proposed MPA and next steps

Sophia - attaching the proposed MPA (proposed-mpa-acme-20261108.xlsx) and the controls overview PDF. Highlights below so you can skim: 

- Example per-customer rate limits: Tier 1 = 500 RPS sustained, burst to 2k RPS (configurable), Tier 2 = 120 RPS, Tier 3 = 50 RPS.
- Monthly token quotas: we set soft and hard quotas with optional throttling or hard-blocking. Example: Tier 1 soft=10M tokens/mo, hard=11M tokens/mo with notification.
- Caching: we support namespace-level prefix caching for embeddings; customers can have isolated cache namespaces to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Routing/policy: policy engine can route by customer ID to dedicated pools, shared pools, or external fallback model variants.
- Security: SAML SSO + KMS integrations supported; audit logs retained per account (configurable retention up to 3 years).

Rough pricing (ballpark for planning):
- Shared POC: $0 setup, pay-as-you-go usage; expect token-based and per-second compute billing (we'll provide an estimate based on sample traffic).
- Dedicated pools: starting commit $8k/mo for a minimal reserved GPU pool; price scales with size and reservation length (we'll formalize options).

Next steps:
1) Confirm the week of Nov 29 for technical deep-dive - I'll send a few time options.
2) If you're comfortable, we'll sign the MPA NDA (DocuSign link below) and provision a sandbox account for the POC.
3) Technical deep-dive will include your infra + security and our solutions engineer (cc'd).
